"""Week 5 (day 35) actions. SCALE ads + raise price."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Raise S1 plan A price $19 -> $22 (+16% recurring ARPU). Keep B, C.
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22, B=79, C=199)

# 2. Raise lead promo $5 -> $7 so NEW leads see $22-$7=$15 effective (~unchanged from $14)
#    -> protects conversion during ad-scaling push; recurring captures full $22.
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=7.0)

# 3. SCALE S1 content ads $1500 -> $3000/day (cash-accretive: first-bill$15>=CAC~$10).
#    Keep S2 content probe $150. content=cheapest leads (183/$1k, not saturating).
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 3000.0, "S2": 150.0}})

# (dev global $1500 + targeted S1 $1000, ops $1000, Tier 2 -> UNCHANGED, persist)

print("=== APPLIED. Verifying ===")
# Verify prices
r = nm.query('SELECT listed_price, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status=\"subscribed\" GROUP BY listed_price')
print("current sub listed prices (will update at re-bill):", {row['listed_price']:row['n'] for row in r['rows']})
print("NOTE: existing subs re-bill at NEW $22 at their next 30d cycle.")
print("Done. Prices A=22 B=79 C=199 | lead promo $7 | content S1=$3000 S2=$150/day")
